amendment_record.reason: The V2 prerequisite pointed directly to results/V2-M4-unprivileged-holdout-summary.json, an ignored machine-local one-shot artifact that was not present in a clean checkout. Re-running or fabricating that already-consumed holdout would violate the scientific record. V3 changes only the prerequisite to the tracked V2-stage-summary.json, whose chain_validation already verifies the same M4 holdout and authorize_reconnection_design_review decision. No I1-V2 development result existed before this amendment; architecture, algorithm, gates, runtime, resources, and all seeds are byte-inherited from V2.
